Tier 7: one team skill, every model

The UXD team's uxd-prototype-create skill run headlessly, once per model and effort, on RHAISTRAT-1527 (Multimodal Support in Gen AI Studio Playground), standalone mode, decisions skipped. Every run got the same RFE snapshot and the same instruction to proceed without confirmation. A structural checker verifies the artifacts the skill promises; Claude Opus 5.5 scores how well the prototype covers the RFE's MVP scope (1 to 5). Pick a run to see what it built. Prototypes that render in a narrow column (GLM 5.3, Haiku 5.5) are shown as generated: they placed the nav and main content straight into pf-v6-c-page without the sidebar and main classes, so the PatternFly grid stacks everything in its first column. The judge reads the HTML, not the render, and did not catch that.
